01

Engineering Max

Build with intention.

The engineering direction of our app factory: a more repeatable path from product requirements to implementation and review.

The focus is on supporting product-building work while preserving deliberate decisions about architecture, quality, and release.

02

Management Max

Keep execution in view.

The management direction: bringing priorities, ownership, and delivery into a coherent operational picture.

The goal is to make the work behind each product easier to understand, coordinate, and follow through.

03

Marketing Max

Connect products with people.

The marketing direction: supporting the planning and execution involved in taking consumer apps to their audiences.

The ambition is to make product storytelling, marketing workflows, and learning from execution more repeatable.

The products ground the possibility.

Focused apps give the company a practical context for exploring better ways to build, operate, and grow mobile products.

Meet the consumer portfolio →
  1. 01

    Start with a specific human need.

    Self-care, cognitive practice, sleep, and fitness each call for a focused experience. Product choices start with that distinct purpose.

  2. 02

    Learn from the work behind it.

    Requirements, priorities, releases, and product storytelling are part of bringing an app to people. These disciplines inform the app factory direction.

  3. 03

    Develop patterns worth reusing.

    The ambition is to carry useful workflows into future products while preserving the judgment each one needs.

    Build ↓Operate ↓Grow ↓
